newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Merlin stage one to cost A$20m - Ashton.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Merlin stage one to cost A$20m - Ashton.

text.p: Ashton Mining Ltd said on Friday the first stage of the development of the Merlin diamond joint venture project in Australia's Northern Territory would cost about A$20 million.
The funds would be spent on a small access road and enough infrastructure for a 0.5 million tonne plant at the site, Ashton chief executive John Robinson told Reuters.
"The next stage would be to bring in other pipes as we can and develop underground and seek to increase the scale to one million tonnes per annum or thereabouts," he added.
